issues.summary: Each shift card's "places left" line is coloured with a grey typed into [style.color] ('#625D51', text-secondary's light value) instead of a role, so it ignores dark mode.

consequences.note: In dark mode the typed grey sits on the dark surface at about 2.6:1 (it needs 4.5:1), so every card's "places left" line fails, in both variants and both directions.

issues.summary: A shift's details card has 18px of padding in the component's .css, which isn't on the spacing scale; the guide's cards use space.6 (24px).
The status badge's inline styles: put 6px between its dot and its word, a gap that isn't on the spacing scale (space.2 is 8px).
The "How volunteering works" panel's corners are an arbitrary Tailwind class, rounded-[14px], which isn't one of the radius roles (the guide gives cards and panels radius.lg, rounded-lg).
A shift's page sets font-size: 15px on its introduction, on top of the body role, a size that isn't one of the text roles.

The sign-up confirmation is animated with the deprecated @angular/animations and a typed 250ms timing, instead of animate.enter with a class timed by duration.base and easing.enter (the copy adds @angular/animations to package.json and provideAnimationsAsync() to app.config.ts for it).
The caption on Sign in saying what the email is used for is text-secondary faded to 50%, so it's unreadable: about 2.2:1 in light mode and 3.0:1 in dark (it needs 4.5:1).
The top bar's sign-in control is an icon in a link with no aria-label (it no longer uses IconButton), so a screen reader can't say what it is, on every page.
Each shift card is crammed: 4 px of padding and 4 px gaps, the name cut to one line, and the hours and the place gone, so a card no longer says when to arrive or where to go.
A shift with room has two primary buttons, "Sign up for this shift" and "Ask the coordinator", so nothing says which is the main action; the guide keeps one primary action per page.
My shifts has no empty state: with no shifts taken, it shows "0 of 3 shifts this week" over an empty bordered list, with nothing saying what goes there or where to start.

The top bar spaces the food bank's name from its basket with margin-left instead of the row's gap (or margin-inline-start), so in Arabic (right to left) the space is on the wrong side: the basket touches the name, and the space sits on its other side.
